listing.name: Hyper Duel / omegakatana92 Saturn recomp
listing.summary: Native Windows x64 and Steam Deck recompilation of Hyper Duel (Japan) for Sega Saturn, built with satrecomp. Launcher, Arcade and Saturn modes, CD-DA music, saves and controller support. SH-2 code is translated ahead of time; no emulator is bundled. Requires your own CUE/BIN disc image; no ROM, BIOS or game data included. GPL-3.0. Source included.
